title: Huawei watch?
body: Are both the classic and sport compatible with Xdrip?Are there any new watches added to the list.I am trying to decide on a watch and the Huawei is very nice but a bit confusing since they have both versions available and the build number is a bit hard to get when purchasing online.

comments.body: Don't get a Huawei. They are no longer running an Android OS, with some xDrip+ necessities left out of the OS.

@siblues Would you please close this issue if it has been resolved?
Otherwise, would you please use the support channels to find out what the user community suggests?
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
Then, please update.
Thanks
